Thanks for taking this on. Attached is our combined SIG questionnaire and ISO27001 scoping form. - A completed SIG matrix (column for "Response" and "Evidence link/file")
- ISO scope statement and whether Redwood's shared services are in or out
- Point of contact for technical walkthrough (security engineer)

Elena —

Got it, thanks. Looping Rishi (security lead) and Priyom (solutions engineer) to coordinate. High-level plan from our side:
1) We will return a filled SIG matrix with per-control mappings to SOC 2/ISO Annex A by Thu EOD PST.
2) We will include an evidence manifest listing S3/Drive locations and sample artifact names; if some items are sensitive we'll ship redacted screenshots or runbooks.
3) Rishi can do a 45-minute technical walkthrough Wed 11:00 AM PST — does that work for your team?

I will also include a short scope statement confirming that Redwood Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) are scoped into ISO evidence only when customers opt in; Hosted API is in scope for SOC2 controls that relate to production. Priyom will start mapping commonly requested SIG controls to our existing control families so we can be quick on the matrix.

Deliverables ETA: 2026-12-17 17:00 PST (SIG matrix + evidence manifest + scope note)

Best,
Olga

Redwood Inference

Olga / team —

Quick notes from my side after a scan of their questionnaire:
- The SIG spreadsheet is heavy on encryption-at-rest keys (SIG-CR-01) and vendor access reviews (SIG-VND-03). We have clear artifacts for both: KMS key policy docs and our Just-In-Time vendor access logs.
- ISO Annex A mapping: we should call out A.10 (Cryptography) and A.9 (Access control) explicitly and include our control owners.
- One potential gap: their questionnaire asks for historical penetration test reports for the last 24 months including remediation timelines. We typically provide a summary plus a sanitized sample report; request approval from Legal for redacted deliverable.

I'll take ownership of the SIG->SOC2/ISO mapping table for controls in the areas above and will add proposed evidence file names/paths in the manifest. Priyom — can you prepare the screenshots/runbook for the JIT vendor workflow and a sample vendor access log export?

Rishi
Head of Reliability & Security Engineering

Thanks — Wed 11:00 AM PST for the walkthrough works for our security lead and James (our procurement consultant). A few clarifications from our side before the call:
- For penetration testing artifacts, redacted sample is fine; we just need evidence of scope, test date, and remediation owner/ticket numbers.

- Can you also confirm whether Redwood's Dedicated offering is considered "in scope" for ISO Annex A controls when the customer provisions dedicated capacity? We usually require that statement in the scope doc.

Elena
